description: List all security cameras in the home.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of camera objects.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full camera object.

description: Register a new camera in the security system.

room.description: Room or location the camera monitors.

night_vision.description: Whether the camera supports night vision.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new camera.

description: Start recording on the given camera and log a recording_started event.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated camera.

description: Stop recording on the given camera and log a recording_stopped event.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated camera.

description: List sensors, optionally filtered by kind and/or room.

kind.description: Optional sensor kind (door, window, motion, smoke, water).

room.description: Optional room name to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of sensor objects sorted by name.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full sensor object.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated sensor.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated sensor.

description: Manually trigger a sensor. Creates a new unresolved alarm and logs a triggered event.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {sensor, alarm}.

description: List alarms, optionally filtering by resolved status (true = resolved, false = unresolved).

resolved.description: Optional filter: true for resolved, false for unresolved.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of alarms sorted by triggered_at desc.

description: Mark an alarm as resolved with optional notes.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the resolved alarm.

description: List security events, optionally filtered by kind and/or source_kind.

kind.description: Optional event kind (e.g. armed, disarmed, triggered, resolved).

source_kind.description: Optional source kind (camera, sensor, alarm, user, system).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of events sorted by timestamp desc.

source_kind.description: One of camera, sensor, alarm, user, system.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new event.

description: List access logs, optionally filtered by user.

user.description: Optional user name to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of access logs sorted by timestamp desc.

description: Record an access log entry (lock/unlock etc.) and emit a matching event.

method.description: One of keypad, phone, keycard, face.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new access log.

description: Arm all sensors at once and log a system armed event.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {armed, total}.

description: Disarm all sensors at once and log a system disarmed event.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {disarmed, total}.

description: Aggregate counts of cameras, sensors, alarms, events, access logs and current active/recording/unresolved counters.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is an object of aggregate counters.
